# FG-DB-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`db-migration`](../../ops/runbooks/db-migration.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `pending_migrations_are_schema_incompatible` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: サーバーとデータベースの版が一致しません。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The server and the database schema do not match. Contact the administrator.
- id: Versi server dan skema basis data tidak cocok. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

The database schema does not match the migrations built into this forge binary, so the server refuses to start (or forge db migrate refuses to run): migrations are pending, the database has migrations this binary does not know (it is newer — e.g. after rolling the binary back), an applied migration was edited, or an earlier run left a migration marked unsuccessful.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (pending, db_ahead, checksum_mismatch, dirty) and `versions` (the affected migration versions). `forge db status` lists applied, pending and unknown versions without changing anything.

## 対処 (fix)

pending: run `forge db migrate` (an approved runbook step). db_ahead: deploy the binary that matches the database (migrations are forward-only). checksum_mismatch / dirty: never edit an applied migration — restore the original file from version control and release a new migration instead.
